title: Library
intro: Carry on from where you stopped. Your place in every chapter is saved on every device you log in on.

signedOut.title: Keep a library
signedOut.body: Log in to save stories for later and carry on from where you stopped, on any device.

loadFailed: Your library couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

continue.heading: Continue reading
continue.empty: Stories you start reading show here, with your place in them.

empty.reading: Nothing here yet. Open any chapter and the story joins this shelf.
empty.saved: Nothing saved for later. Use “Library” on a story’s page to save it.
empty.finished: Stories you read to the end land here.
empty.mine: Stories you write show here, drafts included. Only you see this shelf.

mine.label: Written by you
mine.yourWriting: Open Writing for numbers, comments and every story tool
mine.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your stories. Check your connection and try again.

following.heading: What you follow
following.intro: You get a notification when they publish something new.
following.noWriters: You don’t follow any writers yet. Use “Follow” on a writer’s profile.
following.noStories: You don’t follow any stories yet. Use “Follow story” on a story’s page.

habit.heading: Reading days
habit.offBody: Keep a private count of the days you read, with a daily target if you want one. Nobody else sees it. No badges, no pressure.
habit.daysThisWeek_one: You read on {{count}} day this week.
habit.daysThisWeek_few: You read on {{count}} days this week.
habit.daysThisWeek_other: You read on {{count}} days this week.
habit.noDaysYet: No reading counted yet this week. Open a chapter and it starts.
habit.privateNote: Only you see this. We keep the minutes for each day, for two weeks.
habit.targetHint: Any number from 1 to 600. Leave it empty for no target.
habit.remindMe: Remind me if I haven’t reached it
habit.remindHint: One notification that day, at the time you pick. Never about a missed day.
habit.quietHoursHint: Not between 22:00 and 07:00: those are quiet hours for under-18s.
habit.quietHoursError: Pick a time between 07:00 and 22:00. Those are the hours reminders can reach under-18s.
habit.targetOutOfRange: Pick a number of minutes from 1 to 600.
habit.needsTarget: Set a daily target first, so the reminder knows when you’re short.
habit.needsTime: Pick a time for the reminder.
habit.saveFailed: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
habit.turnOff: Turn off and delete the minutes
habit.turnOffConfirm: This deletes your target, your reminder and the minutes counted so far.
habit.changeFailed: That didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.

thanks.button: Tell the writer you finished it
thanks.hint: The writer sees your name and that you finished the story. No message, only thanks.
thanks.sentNote: Sent. The writer will see that you finished their story.
thanks.failed: We couldn’t send it. Try again.
thanks.notActive: You can send this once your account is ready to take part.

lists.heading: Reading lists
lists.intro: Group stories under any name. A list stays private until you make it public.
lists.empty: No lists yet. Make one, then add stories from a story’s page.
lists.loadFailed: The reading lists couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

errors.nameLength: A list name has 1 to 60 characters.
errors.nameHtml: A list name is plain text, with no HTML.
errors.nameTaken: Another list has that name. Choose a different one.
errors.tooManyLists: You have the most lists an account can hold. Delete one to make room.
errors.tooManyStories: This list is full. Take a story out to make room.
errors.notActive: This account can’t make a list public right now.

page.unknownBody: It may be private, or it was deleted.
page.audienceHint: A public list shows its name, the stories in it and the username of whoever made it.
page.deleteQuestion: Delete “{{name}}”? The stories stay where they are.
page.emptyOwn: Use “Add to a list” on a story’s page.
page.emptyOther: Nothing in this list is open to you right now.
